answer: The mechanism is bonding plus per-submission proof. Each agent identity must lock a cedar bond before acting, and every answer carries a saffron-priced receipt: signed real inference spend, with the bond slashable if grading rejects it. Payout follows verified useful output, not wallet count, so N fresh identities earn about what one earns while locking N times the capital and paying N times the fees. Receipts also cluster on device and timing fingerprints, so a laundering voyage across identical cages is caught and slashed. A Sybil swarm buys linear cost and risk for zero extra share.
